name: Present
source:
Main character is a university student who has a fiancé since promise to marry in early childhood. 
One evening protagonist's cousin appears who promises to make him forget about his fiancé. Will he choose to protect his special relations?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名大学生，自幼便与未婚妻约定结婚。一天傍晚，主角的表亲出现，承诺让他忘记未婚妻。他会选择保护这段特殊关系吗？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
